lines: Syncs with an outside app run on their own schedule, as the person who set them up, and pause in plain words if that person no longer can.
A big sync no longer makes the app pause: the server gives way every few milliseconds, so pages and the live view stay quick.
A server holding tens of thousands of records starts in seconds instead of minutes, and the Console's health page answers at once.
Reading a long list while a sync writes no longer fails with Access changed; the page waits a moment for the new records.
In the schema map, every card stays clear of the others, opened or not, so each button can be pressed.
Send a PDF for signature with no outside service. The signer needs no account, and the signed copy is sealed.
